title: Enterprise resource planning (ERP)
content:
# What ERP apps do Enterprise resource planning (ERP) apps connect TikTok Shop with a seller's back-office operating system. A typical ERP integration supports shop authorization, product and inventory management, order synchronization, fulfillment coordination, financial reconciliation, and, when applicable, return and refund workflows. Use this page when your app is broader than a Connector and needs to coordinate multiple seller operation workflows. If your app only connects TikTok Shop with one or more commerce channels, start with the Connector or MCA requirements. If your app only reconciles settlements and payments, start with the Accounting and Finance requirements. | App type | Primary purpose | Typical TikTok Shop coverage | | --- | --- | --- | | Connector or MCA | Connect TikTok Shop with external commerce channels. | Shop connection, category mapping, product listing, inventory and price sync, order sync, and fulfillment. | | ERP | Connect TikTok Shop with the seller's back-office operating system. | Connector baseline plus inventory operations, order operations, fulfillment, finance, and optional returns. | | Accounting and Finance | Reconcile settlements, payments, withdrawals, and order-level or SKU-level transactions. | Shop connection and finance APIs only, unless the app also works as an ERP or Connector. | # Use case maintenance note Several ERP use cases are shared with the Connector, MCA, Dropshipping, POD, and Accounting categories. To avoid duplicated rules drifting across pages, treat Partner Center, the latest ARD template, and the category-specific requirement page as the source of truth for the shared baseline. This ERP page summarizes how those shared modules apply to ERP apps and lists ERP-specific grouping by workflow and scope. | Shared module | Canonical reference | ERP usage | | --- | --- | --- | | Shop connection, category, listing, order, and fulfillment | [Connector, multi-channel, dropshipping, and print on demand](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/connector-multi-channel-dropshipping-and-print-on-demand) | ERP apps usually implement this baseline when they connect seller systems to TikTok Shop catalog, inventory, order, or fulfillment workflows. | | Finance | [Accounting and Finance](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/accounting-and-finance) | ERP apps implement these use cases when they include settlement, payment, withdrawal, or transaction reconciliation. | | Returns and refunds | Return and Refund API references in Partner Center | ERP apps implement these use cases when sellers manage post-sales operations in the ERP. | # Must-have use case quick reference The table below helps ERP developers decide where to start.
